quality_policy.rule: No technique is included to meet a numeric quota.
quality_policy.inclusion: Each record must have a recognized technical source and/or elite competition/direct-instruction validation, a current rules/safety review, and a distinct technical purpose.
quality_policy.elite_variants: C records are verified and effective but style-dependent; they are not universal defaults.
quality_policy.reference_only: D records, if present, are reference-only and excluded from normal progression.

level_definitions.beginner: Foundational actions with low prerequisite burden; balance, safety and repeatable mechanics come first.
level_definitions.intermediate: Established fundamentals plus timing, chaining, positional awareness or reaction-based execution.
level_definitions.advanced: Higher coordination, reaction dependence, positional risk, rules complexity, specialist execution or elite-system variation.

sources.name: USA Wrestling — Core Curriculum
sources.use: Official Folkstyle Levels 1–3, Olympic Styles Level 1, Freestyle Level 2 and Greco-Roman Level 2.

sources.name: USA Wrestling — Rule Book & Guide
sources.use: Current freestyle/Greco rule guide; UWW official rules supersede it internationally.

sources.name: UWW — Jordan Burroughs classic double-leg
sources.use: World-level validation of the double-leg as a repeatable elite scoring attack.

sources.name: John Smith — Low Single
sources.use: Direct instruction from an Olympic/world champion on his signature low single.

sources.name: John Smith — Championship Wrestling Fundamentals: Cowboy Offense
sources.use: Stance, motion, low single, high crotch, elbow-control attacks, duck-unders and pass-bys.

sources.name: United World Wrestling — Coach Education Pathway
Kyle Dake — Mastering Underhook Offense
sources.use: Underhook entries, snapdowns, drags, duck-unders, throw-bys, headlocks and chain wrestling.

sources.name: Gable Steveson — Gold Standard Wrestling Defense
sources.use: Single-leg defence, front-headlock defence, bottom escapes, top turns, inside trip and super duck.
